description.text: One of the two DP5 expansions released together on 14 March 2008, each made of entirely different Pokémon and Trainer cards. With them the DP series was complete: its five expansions held every Pokémon known at the time except Kadabra and the still unrevealed Shaymin and Arceus. Cry from the Mysterious is led by the legendary Heatran, with Groudon, Kyogre, Rayquaza and Giratina among its Pokémon, and its wrapper is themed on Stark Mountain. Uxie, Mesprit and Rhyperior appear as LV.X. In English it became part of Legends Awakened in August 2008, together with Temple of Anger.
